mapper.update: UPDATE TB_PASSWORD_RESET SET EXPIRED_DATE = SYSDATE - 1, UPDATED_BY = 'SYSTEM', UPDATE_DATE = SYSDATE WHERE USER_ID = #{userId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO TB_PASSWORD_RESET ( COMPANY_CODE, USER_ID, TOKEN_ID, TOKEN, EXPIRED_DATE, CREATED_BY, CREATE_DATE ) VALUES ( #{companyCode}, #{userId}, SUBSTR(RAWTOHEX(SYS_GUID()), 1, 20), #{token}, SYSDATE + (30/1440), 'SYSTEM', SYSDATE )
mapper.select: SELECT COMPANY_CODE, USER_ID, TOKEN_ID, TOKEN, EXPIRED_DATE FROM TB_PASSWORD_RESET WHERE TOKEN = #{token} AND EXPIRED_DATE > SYSDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE TB_PASSWORD_RESET SET EXPIRED_DATE = SYSDATE - 1, UPDATED_BY = 'SYSTEM', UPDATE_DATE = SYSDATE WHERE TOKEN = #{token}
